text:
zoe: heads-up - external vendor asked to schedule a penetration test 2026-05-03 -> 2026-05-05. scope: staging auth, KMS-proxy, and limited webhook surface. need intake checklist + playbook.
kyle: noted. do we want live key unwrap access or wrapped-key exchange only?
frank: wrapped-key exchange only please. avoid direct KMS decrypts from assessor machines. we can offer a short-lived unwrapped-key via proxy for ephemeral sessions.
anya: RBAC suggestion: create `pt:assessor/session` role with `AssumeRole` via proxy, enforced MFA, and session length 3h. label role with `pt-window=2026-05` tag.
ravi: KMS pattern: proxy does KMS:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext then gives wrapped key to assessor. proxy logs include request_id, wrapped_key_id, caller_arn. record logs to immutable archive.
kyle: presigned evidence bucket: TTL 72h, encrypted server-side, path layout `s3://pt-evidence/2026-05/vendor-<id>/`. ensure bucket access only via ingest-lambda and proxy-role.
frank: require manifest.json with sha256 checksums and signer metadata. signer = proxy-signing-key CMK restricted to kms:Sign by `proxy-role`. sample cli: `aws kms sign --key-id alias/proxy-sign --message fileb://manifest.json --signing-algorithm RSASSA_PKCS1_V1_5_SHA_256`
anya: triage SLA proposal: 48h initial triage for critical, 5d for high, 14d for medium. retest windows: vendor asks for canary within 10 days for critical fixes, full retest within 28 days.
zoe: decision: security-eng owns day0 triage (first 48h), then hand to service teams. we'll tag JIRA tickets `pt:vendor=<id>` and `pt:epic=SEC-PT-2026-05`.
sec-bot: created SEC-PT-2026-05 (epic) - https://jira.internal/SEC-PT-2026-05 :white_check_mark:
infra-bot: terraform snippet for role condition (pushed to infra/pt-roles branch):
```
resource "aws_iam_role" "pt_assessor" {
  name = "pt_assessor_2026_05"
  assume_role_policy = jsonencode({
    Version = "2012-10-17",
    Statement = [{
      Effect = "Allow",
      Principal = { AWS = "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/pt-proxy" },
      Action = "sts:AssumeRole",
      Condition = { Bool = { "aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent" = "true" } }
    }]
  })
  max_session_duration = 10800
  tags = { "pt-window" = "2026-05" }
}
```
kyle: evidence hygiene note: scrub auth tokens and PII from evidence artifacts. include only hashed request ids and timestamps.
frank: playback allowance: vendor may replay sanitized traffic in staging only after we approve corpus. require checksumed dataset and run on isolated replay environment. no production endpoints.
ravi: audit flow: stream proxy audit events to `new-log-collector`, snapshot to S3 every 24h, sign manifests, and set object lock retention 90 days.
anya: who signs manifests? ops or infra? we should use CMK signing with a key controlled by security team.
infra-bot: recommended command to verify signature on ingest lambda: `aws kms verify --key-id alias/proxy-sign --message fileb://manifest.json --signature fileb://manifest.sig --signing-algorithm RSASSA_PKCS1_V1_5_SHA_256`
zoe: action items: 1) create JIRA epic and checklist (sec-bot done), 2) infra to push role + proxy changes, 3) security to own day0 triage and evidence template, 4) ops to schedule dry-run week before.
kyle: dry-run request: schedule vendor dry-run 2026-04-27 16:00 UTC. 
frank: i'll prepare the sanitized replay corpus and evidence manifest template.
ravi: i'll draft the audit snapshot playbook and signature verification steps.
anya: thanks all. i'll publish intake doc and calendar invites. tag me for triage ownership handoff. :calendar:
